result.summary: Advisory review found two supported readiness defects: unreconciled IN_PROGRESS advisory claims can be bypassed into formal entry, and some accepted formal FAIL records cannot be converted into the required advisory fix checklist.

criteria.explanation: Readiness declaration is explicit, requires fast and focused checks, launches the provider only when Judge is applicable, and revised declarations bind the current pinned source.
The advisory input uses compact pinned source, approved spec/design, fast/focused evidence, fullVerification PENDING, and receipts are checked against the formal Judge capability/isolation contract.

Clean advisory output is represented as READY_FOR_FORMAL_REVIEW with PENDING full verification, non-clean formal entry requires a retained reason, and advisory passage does not record a formal gate outcome.
Formal FAIL records accepted without structured concern findings cannot be mapped into defect-class remediation with invariant and affected paths.
Because accepted formal failures may have no structured findings, a rerun cannot receive every prior formal finding as a fix checklist item.
The advisory prompt requests all supported findings, keeps distinct defects separate, and remediation recurrence requires failed-fix explanation plus changed approach without adding a count halt.
Tracked advisory records retain source/input identity, findings or operational errors, compact receipts, and are checked as committed evidence before formal entry.
Clean reuse is keyed to the full advisory input identity, including compact review input, resources, checks, prior findings, governance and opaque record-space data; changed inputs are rejected.
Formal entry can be made eligible for an advisory whose execution is only IN_PROGRESS, without an unavailable result or exhausted retry.
Codex and Claude adapters share the same plugin-local workflow resources and protocol adapter operations, with stable operational outcomes exposed through CLI/plugin entrypoints.

scopeCheck.explanation: The review covered the supplied slice files, approved spec/design and every declared in-scope criterion R1,R2,R3,R6,R7,R8,R9,R10,R11,R23.

gapCheck.explanation: The slice has behavioral gaps for unreconciled advisory claims and formal FAIL records lacking structured concern findings.

contradictionCheck.explanation: The shipped guidance says an IN_PROGRESS execution claim must be reconciled, but the boundary proof validator and disposition check can accept IN_PROGRESS with a proceed reason.

findings.summary: Proceed can admit formal entry while advisory execution is still IN_PROGRESS.
findings.invariant: A retained proceed reason may bypass only a completed non-clean advisory disposition such as FINDINGS or UNAVAILABLE after the retry/error contract, not an unreconciled execution claim.
evidence: plugin-src/shared/resources/commands/advisory-review.md:53 states an execution claim without a result is IN_PROGRESS and must be reconciled.
plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/advisory.js:775 records proceed reasons after only finding readiness.json; it does not require a review result or unavailable disposition.
plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/advisory.js:889 treats missing review.json as IN_PROGRESS, and lines 893-895 accept any non-clean outcome when proceed.json exists.

plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/advisory.js:916 can bind proof.review to claim.json, while plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/advisory-contract.js:544-550 explicitly permits IN_PROGRESS with proceed evidence.

findings.summary: Formal Judge FAIL records can be accepted without structured findings, then cannot enter the advisory checklist.
findings.invariant: Every recorded formal code failure that drives revised readiness must expose structured supported findings with invariant and affected paths so advisory reruns can bind and check them exactly once.
evidence: plugin-src/shared/resources/agent-workflows/judge/result.schema.json:55 defines findings as an array without minItems or any requirement tied to FAIL results.
plugin-src/shared/resources/agent-workflows/judge/validator.js:21-24 derives FAIL solely from criteria/scope/gap/contradiction results and does not require concern findings for a FAIL verdict.

plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/advisory-history.js:110-113 later requires at least one severity concern finding before building prior formal advisory findings, so an accepted formal FAIL with empty findings cannot become the required checklist/remediation input.
